( Atelier Nord ) Studies in Form and Light

Atelier Nord is a visual identity shaped by material studies, quiet typography, and changing light. The project brings print, photography, and digital experience into one flexible language.

A quiet system for a changing cultural landscape.

Beginning with material texture and shifting light, the project develops a visual language across printed matter and digital space. Its identity remains open, changing with the time and place in which it is seen.

Space, typography, and photography are organized as a single system, allowing each expression to remain flexible while holding a quiet sense of continuity.
